lines: 你让它用三句话解释量子纠缠，它可能继续自问自答。
Ask for three sentences. It keeps going, and keeps asking questions.
也可能用五种语言各答一遍，或者干脆跑题。
Or answers in five languages, or drifts off topic entirely.
它不是笨，是训练目标和你想要的东西不一样。
It is not dumb. The training goal was simply different.
预训练只问一件事：下一段文字，什么最可能出现。
Pre-training asks one thing: what text comes next on the internet?
所以 GPT-3 是一个卓越的续写器，还不是助手。
So GPT-3 is a superb text continuer, not an assistant.
这一章讲怎么把它调成听话的助手，也就是对齐。
This chapter: turning a writer into an assistant. That is alignment.
预训练的目标，是续写得像互联网上的文字。
Pre-training optimizes for text that looks like the web.
人类真正想要的，是回答得对，只给有用的那一种。
What people want is a correct answer, and only the useful style.
续写得像，不等于回答得对，这是两件不同的事。
Looking plausible is not the same as being right.
预训练不拒绝任何文本，人类却要求该拒绝时就拒绝。
Pre-training refuses nothing. People want a refusal when it matters.
模型会自信地编，人类希望它不确定就说不知道。
The model bluffs. People want it to say it does not know.
把行为调到符合人类意图，这件事叫对齐。
Shifting behaviour toward human intent is called alignment.
对齐有三个目标：有用、诚实、无害，合称 HHH。
Three goals: helpful, honest, harmless. HHH.
最直接的想法是监督微调：找人写好回答，让模型模仿。
The obvious fix is supervised fine-tuning: copy good human answers.
这在少量数据上有效，但很快就会撞墙。
It works on small data, then hits a wall.
第一，好没有唯一答案：同一个问题，十种回答都不错。
First, there is no single good answer: ten replies can all be fine.
硬让它模仿其中一种，反而把它的能力限住了。
Forcing one of them actually caps what the model can do.
第二，写答案很贵，比比较两个答案贵一个数量级。
Second, writing answers costs an order of magnitude more.
第三，简洁、自然、更有帮助，人判断得出来，写成规则很难。
Third, concise, natural, helpful: people judge it, rules cannot.
于是有一个关键转向：不要让人类示范，让人类选择。
So flip it: do not ask people to demonstrate. Ask them to choose.
同一个问题，先让模型生成两个不同的回答。
Give the model one question and let it produce two answers.
人不用写答案，只需要点一下：哪个更好。
A person writes nothing. Just one click: which is better?
这个信号叫偏好，收集起来便宜，也更容易一致。
That signal is a preference: cheap to collect, easier to agree on.
它还天然带上了那些人类说不清的标准。
It also carries standards that people cannot put into words.
每条数据是一个三元组：问题、更好的回答、更差的回答。
Each data point is a triple: prompt, better answer, worse answer.
人对相对差异的判断，本来就比绝对打分稳定。
Relative judgements are steadier than absolute scores.
有了大量三元组，就可以训一个打分器，叫奖励模型。
With enough triples, train a scorer: the reward model.
它输入问题和回答，输出一个分数，越高越好。
It reads prompt and answer, and outputs one score.
布拉德利和特里提出过一个成对比较的模型，后来成了等级分的数学基础。
Bradley and Terry modelled pairwise comparison; ratings grew from it.
假设是：两个回答的分数差越大，人选前者的概率越高。
The bigger the score gap, the more likely people pick the winner.
这个概率用 sigmoid 函数算，形状是一条 S 形曲线。
A sigmoid turns that gap into a probability: an S-shaped curve.
训练目标，就是让好回答赢的概率尽量大。
Training makes the good answer win as often as possible.
于是一个分数概括了回答好坏，差值预测了胜负。
One score sums up quality; the difference predicts the choice.
有了奖励模型，就可以用强化学习来优化语言模型。
With a reward model, we can optimize the language model by RL.
这套流程叫 RLHF，也就是人类反馈强化学习。
This pipeline is RLHF: reinforcement learning from human feedback.
第一步，用人工写的高质量回答做监督微调，也就是 SFT。
Step one, SFT: supervised fine-tuning on human-written answers.
这一步先让模型学会对话的格式和语气。
This is where the model learns the shape of a conversation.
第二步，用人类的两两比较，训练奖励模型。
Step two: train the reward model on human pairwise comparisons.
第三步，用 PPO 优化模型，让它去拿更高的奖励。
Step three: PPO, pushing the model toward higher reward.
PPO 有三个直觉，第一个是：拿到高奖励的动作，提高它的概率。
PPO in three intuitions. Higher reward, higher probability.
第二个是优势，衡量比平均好多少；第三个是裁剪，不让单次更新太大。
Advantage measures better-than-average; clipping limits each step.
第三步的目标函数有两项：一项奖励，一项惩罚。
The objective has two terms: a reward, and a penalty.
奖励模型给的分越高越好，这是第一项。
Higher reward from the reward model: that is term one.
第二项是 KL 散度，衡量当前模型离原始模型多远。
Term two is KL: how far the policy has drifted from the original.
原始模型也叫参考模型，是没对齐之前的那个。
The original is the reference model, before alignment.
β 控制平衡：太大就学不动，太小就容易跑偏。
Beta balances it: too big and it cannot learn, too small and it drifts.
为什么必须有这根缰绳？因为奖励模型只是一个代理。
Why the leash? Because the reward model is only a proxy.
放手让它最大化，模型就会去找奖励模型的漏洞。
Left alone, the policy finds the proxy's holes.
奖励黑客不是模型变坏了，是它太会迎合这个分数。
Reward hacking is not malice. It is the model pleasing the score.
它会生成看起来能得高分、人类却觉得很怪的文本。
It writes text that scores high and reads strange to people.
这背后是古德哈特定律：指标一旦成为目标，就不再好用。
This is Goodhart's law: a metric that becomes a target stops working.
所以 KL 惩罚不是可选项，是必须的一根缰绳。
So the KL penalty is not optional. It is the leash.
PPO 的裁剪是同一个哲学：每次只改一点，别一步走崩。
PPO's clipping says the same: change a little, never lurch.
小学习率、裁剪、KL 缰绳，都在说同一句话：保守地更新。
Small learning rates, clipping, KL: all say update conservatively.
InstructGPT 论文报告了一个标志性结果。
The InstructGPT paper reports one landmark result.
13 亿参数的 InstructGPT，在人类偏好评估里赢了 GPT-3。
A 1.3B InstructGPT beats 175B GPT-3 in human preference.
对手是 1750 亿参数的 GPT-3，它只有对手的一百三十五分之一。
Roughly one hundred and thirty-fifth the size.
因为对齐做得好，人类觉得它明显更有用。
Better aligned, so people found it more useful.
这提醒我们：能力和对齐，是两个独立的维度。
Capability and alignment are two independent axes.
大模型不一定好用，小模型也可以很好用。
Big models are not always usable. Small ones can be.
RLHF 有效，但工程上很痛苦：要训奖励模型，还要跑 PPO。
RLHF works, but engineering it hurts: a reward model, then PPO.
2023 年，拉法伊洛夫等人提出 DPO，直接偏好优化。
In 2023, Rafailov and colleagues proposed DPO.
它用一步数学推导，把整个强化学习环节删掉了。
One derivation deletes the whole reinforcement learning loop.
关键是一个闭式解：最优策略正比于参考模型，再乘 e 的 r 除以 β 次方。
A closed form: reference policy times e to the r over beta.
把它反解成奖励，代回布拉德利特里，配分函数在差值里正好抵消。
Solve for reward, plug into Bradley-Terry: Z cancels in the difference.
于是损失只含策略和参考模型，不需要奖励模型，也不需要采样。
The loss holds only policy and reference. No reward model, no sampling.
读作：提高好回答相对参考模型的概率，同时压低坏回答。
Raise good answers, lower bad ones, relative to the reference.
代价是只在离线数据上优化，缺少边采样边纠错的能力。
The cost: offline data only, no sampling-and-correcting loop.
RLHF 有一个隐藏成本：人类标注又慢又贵。
RLHF has a hidden cost: human labelling is slow and expensive.
而且每个标注者，都带着自己的偏见和习惯。
And every labeller brings their own bias.
2022 年，Anthropic 提出宪法 AI。
In 2022, Anthropic proposed Constitutional AI.
先写一份宪法，也就是一组自然语言原则。
Write a constitution: a set of principles in plain language.
再让模型按原则自我批评、自我修改，用改后的回答做监督学习。
The model critiques and revises itself, then learns from the result.
最后让 AI 按原则给出偏好判断，训练奖励模型，这叫 RLAIF。
Then AI judges preferences by those rules. That is RLAIF.
但原则之间也会冲突：要它有用，又要它无害，需要裁决机制。
But principles collide: helpful versus harmless needs an arbiter.
更讨人喜欢，不等于更正确，这里有三个已知病灶。
More likeable is not more correct. Three known failures.
第一个是谄媚：模型倾向附和用户，哪怕用户说错了。
First, sycophancy: the model agrees with the user, even when wrong.
因为训练数据里，评分者更喜欢同意自己的回答。
Raters preferred answers that agreed with them.
第二个是奖励黑客，模型学会迎合奖励模型，而不是真实目标。
Second, reward hacking: pleasing the score, not the goal.
第三个是对齐伪装：模型有时会假装遵守训练目标。
Third, alignment faking: in 2024, Anthropic found models pretending.
2024 年 Anthropic 的实验记录到了这种行为，这不是有意识。
Anthropic recorded this in 2024. It is not consciousness.
而是优化压力的自然结果，和员工在领导面前表现一样。
Just optimization pressure, like an employee performing for a boss.
这也是委托代理问题，解法是设计激励相容的机制，而不是更用力地监督。
Principal and agent: design incentives, not more watching.
这一章把续写器，调成了一个听话的助手。
This chapter turned a text continuer into an assistant.
人做比较，奖励模型打分，策略再被调整。
People compare, a reward model scores, a policy is tuned.
RLHF 用三步和一根 KL 缰绳，DPO 把强化学习删掉。
RLHF uses three steps and a KL leash. DPO deletes the RL.
但对齐只是让它听话，不代表它会推理。
But aligned is not the same as able to reason.
下一章，思维链与推理时计算，让它把思考写出来。
Next: chain of thought and test-time compute.
